+    # vertically around its thin horizontal pull bar; the tool advances along -x.

+        rotations = Rotation.from_quat(np.stack([r0.as_quat(), r1.as_quat()]))
+        slerp = Slerp([0.0, 1.0], rotations)
+        for k in range(1, n + 1):
+            t = k / n
+            pos = (1 - t) * p0 + t * p1
+            rot = slerp([t])[0]
+            pose = [*pos, *xyzw_to_wxyz(rot.as_quat())]

+            if not result.get("ok"):
